summary: Lists pods for an Operator upgrade from a 2.4 redundant controller-only deployment with two mesh ingress pods and external database to the 2.6 enterprise topology, which also needs external Redis and object storage for hub.
questions: What pods does the 2.6 Operator enterprise topology need?
Does the AAP 2.6 enterprise topology need external Redis?
How many EDA worker pods are in the Operator enterprise topology?
Upgrade multi node controller on OpenShift from 2.4 to 2.6 requirements

answer_card.title: 2.6 Operator enterprise topology pods
answer_card.answer_md:
- Controller: 1 web, 1 task pod; 2 automation mesh ingress pods
- Automation hub: 1 web, 1 API, 2 content, 2 worker, 1 Redis pod
- Event-Driven Ansible: 1 API, 2 activation worker, 2 default worker, 2 event stream, 1 scheduler pod
- 1 platform gateway pod
- Externally managed database, Redis, and object storage (for hub)
